Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_records, compound_structures, activities, docs, assays, target_dictionary. Join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno to parent compound CHEMBL493620, join child molecules via molregno, join compound_records on molregno, join activities on record_id, join docs on doc_id, join assays on assay_id, join target_dictionary on tid, join compound_structures on molregno. Filter parent chembl_id = 'CHEMBL493620', target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL612557', standard_type = 'IC50'. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
